+*   Google's local search algorithm uses three core components: Proximity, Relevance, and Prominence.
+*   **Proximity:** Physical distance between user/search location and business. Ensure accurate Name, Address, Phone Number (NAP) on Google Business Profile (GBP) and other listings.
+*   **Relevance:** How well a business listing matches the search query. Influenced by business categories, website keywords, user-generated content (reviews).
+*   **Prominence:** How well-known and trusted a business is. Influenced by backlinks, social media mentions, online reviews, and web mentions.
+
+**Local Pack / Maps Ranking Factors (Grouped, 2026 Survey):**
+1.  Google Business Profile (32%)
+2.  Reviews (20%)
+3.  On-page (15%)
+4.  Behavioral (9%)
+5.  Links (8%)
+6.  Citations (6%)
+7.  Personalization (6%)
+8.  Social (4%)
+
+**Local Organic Ranking Factors (Grouped, 2026 Survey):**
+1.  On-page (33%)
+2.  Links (24%)
+3.  Behavioral (10%)
+4.  Personalization (8%)
+5.  Google Business Profile (7%)
+6.  Citations (7%)
+7.  Reviews (6%)
+8.  Social (5%)
+
+**Changes from 2023 to 2026 Survey:**
+*   On-page factors decreased slightly for both local pack (from 19% to 15%) and local organic (from 36% to 33%).
+*   Reviews increased in importance for local pack rankings (from 16% to 20%).
+*   Link signals continued to drop, especially for local pack rankings.
+*   Citations remained steady but gained importance in AI visibility factors.
+*   Social signals were added back as a group in 2026, potentially impacting other factors' percentages.
+
+**Top 15 Individual Local Pack / Maps Ranking Factors (2026 Survey):**
+1.  Primary GBP category
+2.  Proximity of address to the point of search
+3.  Keywords in GBP business title
+4.  Physical address in the city of search
+5.  Business is open at the time of search

+15. HTML NAP matching GBP NAP
+

## Decision (2026-10-31)

No lever moves. Local-pack factors (Google Business Profile ~32%, proximity/relevance/prominence) apply to a business with a public address; WorkHive has none listed - LocalBusiness schema is optional and its address is Ian-gated (MAXIMIZATION_ROADMAP line 195). Nothing cites this source yet.
